build: The unmodified pinned CPU was compiled by the repository conformance recipe with GGML_CPU_GENERIC, -ffp-contract=off and one worker.
reference: For type t and lane i generate (i/256+1) * (0.85f + ((17*i + 7*t) mod 31)/100.f) with integer row division and a negative sign when (13*i+t) mod 11 < 5. Use ggml_quantize_chunk to build the stored inputs and original type traits to decode them. Reverse the two right rows. Run original F32 GGML graphs once per tuple. Encode each result with the original CPU from_float callback where defined, otherwise ggml_quantize_chunk using uniform importance when required. F32 right operands for ADD already have VT-169 and VT-176 evidence.
